## Weekly readings

Every week will have a reading assignment and an exercise. The assigned reading, sections, guiding questions, and deadline belong on that week's page. The slots currently say **not assigned yet**.

## ML computational-economics literature

The final part of the course is provisionally reserved for recent computational literature using machine-learning methods. Specific papers and session lengths will be discussed later. No list of "latest papers" is being assigned at this stage.

For each selected paper, we will prepare:

- The economic question and model.
- The computational bottleneck and proposed ML method.
- Benchmarks, accuracy checks, and limitations.
- Available code/data and a possible small replication exercise.
- Reading questions and a topic-based slide deck.

## Research-agent and tool readings

Lab readings will support research workflows using LLM agents and regular tools such as Git. Tool choices, documentation links, and hands-on tasks remain to be selected. These resources will be recorded alongside the academic literature so that each assignment has a clear source.
